name: Vegetable Yakisoba
ingredientsText: COOKED YAKISOBA NOODLES (WATER, WHEAT FLOUR, CORN STARCH, SALT), CABBAGE, SOY SAUCE (WATER, SOYBEANS, SALT, WHEAT, ALCOHOL), SOYBEAN OIL, CARROTS, BROCCOLI, CHINESE PEA PODS, SUGAR, WATER CHESTNUTS, CONTAINS 2% OR LESS OF: EDAMAME SOYBEANS, SHIITAKE MUSHROOMS, ASPARAGUS, RED BELL PEPPERS, WATER, CORN STARCH, SALT, SESAME OIL, GARLIC PUREE, BLACK PEPPER.
notes: Water chestnuts are not a tree nut. Edamame and soy sauce are soy; sesame oil is sesame.
